purpose: Non-admission research index of ten free/open-source geocoding, spatial SQL, raster, grid and web-map tools complementary to active GIS source PR #1239; tools are NOT original CAT data, production geocoding authorization or model inputs.

entries.name: Nominatim self-hosted OpenStreetMap geocoder
entries.spatial_scope: Worldwide to the extent of an explicitly acquired and version-pinned OpenStreetMap extract
entries.temporal_scope: Software release and imported OSM data snapshot are separately versioned; reviewed 2026-11-04
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Address and place forward/reverse search returning candidate coordinates and OSM objects, not surveyed building-level truth
entries.note: Software licensing differs by component: current repository README lists Python GPL-3.0-or-later, Lua Apache-2.0 and other files GPLv2. OSM data are ODbL; licensed source snapshot and attribution are separate. OSMF's public nominatim.openstreetmap.org service disallows systematic reverse-grid queries and autocomplete, caps requests at 1/s and restricts longer bulk work; do NOT use it as a background world-geocoding worker. This is a software/workflow discovery, not a new independent address dataset, measured building footprint, approved exposure asset, or permission to export customer locations.

entries.name: libpostal international address parsing and normalization
entries.spatial_scope: Global, language and address-format performance dependent on training data and country
entries.temporal_scope: Software and model-data releases separately pinned; reviewed 2026-11-04
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Tokens and normalized address variants; it does not geocode to surveyed coordinates
entries.note: MIT-licensed software per upstream LICENSE. Statistical model artifacts and source/training-data lineage need an exact-version and terms review; parsing errors can reorder units, house numbers or street names. Preserve untouched input, parser/model version, country and language hints, and per-field alternatives. Do not publish sensitive/customer address text or infer an exact building match from a successfully parsed string.

entries.name: DuckDB Spatial extension for local and external geospatial analysis
entries.spatial_scope: Worldwide, conditional on separately lawfully acquired spatial datasets
entries.temporal_scope: Version-pinned DuckDB core and spatial extension required; reviewed 2026-11-04
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Geometry SQL and GDAL-backed vector reads; preserves source geometry but does not provide observations
entries.note: DuckDB core is MIT licensed; verify spatial extension/bundled GDAL dependency and exact binary licenses for deployment. Extension is useful for versioned Overture GeoParquet partitions and bounded joins, not a canonical insurer database or primary record of building identity. Pin CRS, EPSG axis order, geometry validity, polygon-area units, input asset hash, data licence and output count/hash. Do not move provider bytes into public Git.

entries.name: PostGIS spatial joins and persistent geometry storage
entries.spatial_scope: Worldwide, dependent on independently admitted and versioned source features
entries.temporal_scope: Use exact PostgreSQL/PostGIS extension versions on the selected isolated insurance database branch
entries.resolution_or_granularity: OGC geometry/geography types and spatial predicates; no bundled global asset inventory
entries.note: PostGIS is GPLv2 and its official FAQ distinguishes database use from distributing modified PostGIS source code. Existing synthetic-only PostGIS/Neon joins in OpenCatastrophe-data are not real insurer exposure admissions. Require exact geometry SRID and source identity, ST_Covers/ST_Intersects semantics, distance buffer CRS, split/merge ambiguity, and rights before ever promoting spatial matches. This is tool discovery, not authorization to write production Neon.

entries.name: H3 hierarchical hexagonal geospatial index
entries.spatial_scope: Global grid on the Earth's surface
entries.temporal_scope: Library/API version and chosen resolution fixed per run; reviewed 2026-11-04
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Discrete hierarchical hexagonal cells, not building parcel boundaries or geocoded evidence
entries.note: Apache-2.0 software. H3 cell IDs are computational bins, not official postcode/admin boundaries or stable physical building IDs. Boundary crossings, polar distortion, partial-cell and spatial-resolution effects require tests, especially for flood/coastal exposure and multi-peril correlations. A cell intersection is not proof that a specific building is damaged or insured.

entries.name: QGIS desktop GIS quality-control and reproducible cartography
entries.spatial_scope: Global, contingent on input datasets, plugins and raster/vector service access
entries.temporal_scope: Pin QGIS and plugin versions, saved processing parameters and input data vintages
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Interactive vector/raster viewing, overlay and processing; presentation/diagnostics rather than data creation
entries.note: QGIS upstream describes GPL-2.0-or-later licensing. Interactive map inspection is useful for disputed polygons, NoData, elevation and split/merge cases but is not reproducible evidence by itself; export command or processing history, layer CRS, styling, project version and numerical tests. Basemap tiles or third-party plugins may have separate licenses and terms.

entries.name: GDAL/OGR raster and vector geospatial conversion toolkit
entries.spatial_scope: Global spatial formats with supported drivers
entries.temporal_scope: Exact GDAL binary, drivers, PROJ and dependent library versions; reviewed 2026-11-04
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Raster/vector read, warp, reproject, cutline, translation and format conversion; not a source of hazard measurements
entries.note: GDAL/OGR source is generally MIT licensed, but official documentation warns binary dependencies and drivers can impose different terms. Reprojection must preserve CRS, axis order, coordinate epoch and vertical datum; raster alignment, pixel-as-area conventions, NoData, resampling and depth units need explicit receipts. GDAL cannot confer reuse rights on transformed upstream data.

entries.name: MapLibre GL JS interactive web map rendering
entries.spatial_scope: Global map display where authorized vector/raster tile data exist
entries.temporal_scope: Versioned JS renderer, style and tileset snapshots; reviewed 2026-11-04
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Browser vector tile rendering, layer styling and user interaction; no address geocoder or risk hazard dataset included
entries.note: BSD-3-Clause software; renderer and map styles do not grant map tile, basemap or provider-data rights. Reserve public OpenCatastrophe-data for references and reproducibility metadata, and display only legally permitted spatial layers; never expose confidential insurer positions or loss records in public map tiles. Map visualization alone is not evidence of a model-ready building match.

entries.name: PMTiles versioned static geospatial tile archive
entries.spatial_scope: Global or regionally bounded tilesets, based entirely on chosen inputs
entries.temporal_scope: Pin PMTiles specification/implementation, generated tileset hash and all source vintages
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Single-file tile archive for range-request retrieval and offline/remote static publication
entries.note: Reference implementations use BSD-3-Clause; format specification public domain/CC0. The license of the PMTiles container is not the license of any tileset or underlying OSM/Overture layers. Tile generalization, dropped attributes, scale thresholds and caching can alter visual detail; risk and loss computations must use original version-pinned numerical geometry or raster, not map-display tiles.

entries.name: GeoServer OGC map and feature serving
entries.spatial_scope: Global or regional services backed by authorized datasets
entries.temporal_scope: Pin GeoServer/OGC extension and layer configuration versions; reviewed 2026-11-04
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Server publishes OGC-facing WMS/WFS/related services, not underlying observed data
entries.note: GeoServer is GPL-licensed (official source and notices describe GPLv2 or later). Hosting and publishing separate spatial services entail network security, authorization, cache, service and layer-level rights reviews. WMS imagery is not necessarily suitable as analytical numeric hazard input; prefer exact original raster/vector bytes and declared coordinate systems for loss calculations. Start with static PMTiles for approved visualization and add GeoServer only when OGC operations are needed.
